name: PM
description: Teaches the 8AM class with unreasonable cheer and a squeaky marker. Remembers every face, and especially every empty seat. Never called anything but PM.

name: Lou
description: Cooks pasta at midnight, studies at dawn and knows everyone's business on campus. Becomes the friend who tells you the truth at every big turn of your life.

name: Noa
description: Met outside a sète at 3AM, deep in a conversation about AI, free will and kebabs. Funny, curious, a little chaotic. Could become a friend, a partner, or a lifelong what-if.

name: Bertrand
description: Says 'quick question' before forty-minute questions and 'no pressure' before a lot of pressure. Taught you how work works, for better and worse.

name: Malik
description: Ran the asso with you as a student, slept even less than you, and still runs on cold brew and big ideas. Will call one day with a startup and a very long deck.

name: Your partner
description: The person who shares your flat, your calendar and your worst jokes. Asks the questions you avoid.

name: Your kid
description: Arrives with a lot of noise and opinions. Grows up into a teenager who judges your playlists, your screen time and your carbon footprint.
